items.source: Computes a prefix to be used on multiple properties on a node when this persistent property is annotated with @CompositeProperty.
items.translation: 当此持久化属性被标注为@CompositeProperty时，计算用于该节点上多个属性的前缀。

items.source: A flag is this is a read only property, can be changed via PersistentPropertyCharacteristics.
items.translation: flag 是一个只读属性，可以通过 PersistentPropertyCharacteristics 接口进行修改。

items.source:
Dynamic associations are associations to non-simple types stored in a map with a
key type of java.lang.String or enum.
items.translation: 动态关联是指存储在 Map 中的对非简单类型的关联，其键类型为 java.lang.String 或枚举类型。

items.source:
Flag if this property points to a collection of dynamic labels for the owning
entity.
items.translation: 标记此属性是否指向所属实体的动态标签集合。

items.source:
Dynamic one-to-many associations are associations to non-simple types stored in a
map with a key type of java.lang.String and values of
java.util.Collection.
items.translation: 动态的一对多关联是指指向非简单类型的关联，这些类型存储在以 `java.lang.String` 为键、`java.util.Collection` 为值的 Map 中。

items.source: Returns true if this property belongs to a relationship.
items.translation: 如果此属性属于关系，则返回 true。
